About Cookies on This Site

We use cookies, including cookies from third parties, to enhance your user experience and the effectiveness of our marketing activities. These cookies are performance, analytics and advertising cookies, please see our Privacy and Cookie policy for further information. If you agree to all of our cookies select “Accept all” or select “Cookie Settings” to see which cookies we use and choose which ones you would like to accept.

Cookies Setting
Absolutely Necessary Cookies
These are cookies that are absolutely essential to running a website. This category of cookies cannot be disabled.
Functional Cookies
These cookies are used to provide you with convenient functions, such as product reviews and product video playback, during your web browsing, they also enable interaction with social media accounts.
Social media
Connect with your social channels to share LG Technology with friends for example on Facebook and Twitter.
Analytics Cookies
These cookies allow our website to keep improving functions through website traffic analysis and to suggest personalized content for you.
Advertising Cookies
These cookies enable us to show you ads and other content that we think is most attuned to your interests and digital behavior.

Learn more about 4K UHD TVs

Step into a more immersive entertainment experience with LG 4K UHD TVs, offering detailed visuals, vibrant colours, and smart features for everyday viewing. Explore different screen sizes and specifications to find a TV that complements your space and entertainment needs. Compare before you buy and order online to make a well-informed choice. From movies and sports to streaming and gaming, LG 4K UHD TVs bring impressive picture quality and convenient features to your home.

Learn more

Frequently Asked Questions

Q.

What is a 4K UHD LED TV and how does it work?

A.

An LG 4K UHD LED TV is designed to deliver an enhanced entertainment experience with intelligent picture and sound technologies. It combines AI-powered processing with advanced display features to optimize content, improve visual quality, and provide seamless access to smart entertainment through the latest webOS platform.

 

How Does an LG 4K UHD TV Work?

 

● α7 AI Processor Gen8: Offers faster processing to deliver enhanced 4K picture quality with improved sharpness and depth.
● 4K Super Upscaling: Improves the quality of lower-resolution content for sharper visuals.
● HDR10 Pro: Enhances brightness and contrast for more vivid images.
● AI Sound Pro: Delivers an immersive audio experience by optimizing sound automatically.
● webOS Re:New Program: Provides software upgrades for an enhanced smart TV experience.
● ThinQ AI: Offers smart features and personalized recommendations for easy navigation.
● FILMMAKER MODE™: Preserves content in the creator's intended format for an authentic viewing experience.

Q.

What is the 4K TV for home entertainment?

A.

A 4K TV for home entertainment is a modern television designed to deliver ultra-high-definition picture quality and an immersive viewing experience. With four times the resolution of Full HD, it provides sharp details, rich colors, and more realistic visuals, making movies, shows, sports, and games more engaging for everyday home use.

 

What Is a 4K TV for Home Entertainment?

 

● Ultra HD Resolution: Offers four times more detail than standard Full HD TVs.
● Enhanced Picture Quality: Delivers sharper images with improved clarity and depth.
● Vivid Colors: Produces more accurate and lifelike color reproduction.
● Immersive Viewing: Ideal for movies, sports, gaming, and streaming content.
● Large Screen Experience: Maintains clarity even on large screen sizes.
● Modern Entertainment Hub: Supports streaming apps and smart features for convenience.
● Home-Friendly Design: Built to suit everyday family entertainment needs.

Q.

Which are the 4K TVs for HDR Content?

A.

A 4K TV for HDR content is designed to deliver enhanced picture quality by combining Ultra High Definition resolution with High Dynamic Range technology. This combination helps improve brightness, contrast, and color accuracy, resulting in more realistic and immersive visuals for movies, shows, sports, and gaming. Different HDR formats such as HDR10, Dolby Vision, and HLG are used across various 4K TVs to optimize content based on scene and lighting conditions. These TVs ensure deeper blacks, brighter highlights, and richer colors, making the viewing experience more lifelike. Whether it is LED, OLED, or smart 4K TVs, HDR support plays a major role in delivering cinematic-quality entertainment at home.

Q.

What is a 4K UHD LED Smart TV and what are its benefits?

A.

A 4K UHD LED Smart TV is a modern television that combines ultra-high-definition picture quality with smart connectivity features. It delivers sharp visuals, vibrant colors, and seamless access to digital entertainment, making everyday viewing more immersive and convenient.

● Provides 4K Ultra HD resolution for sharp, detailed, and clear picture quality even on large screens.
● Enhances viewing with better color accuracy and contrast for more realistic and vibrant visuals.
● Offers smart connectivity to access streaming apps, online content, and digital platforms.
● Supports internet and wireless connectivity for smooth and convenient use.
● Enables easy navigation and smart controls for a user-friendly experience.
● Suitable for movies, sports, gaming, and daily entertainment in one integrated device.

Q.

What features should I look for in a 4K UHD TV?

A.

A 4K UHD TV provides sharp picture quality and can upgrade your overall viewing experience. Select the right features to enjoy better performance, value, and long-term satisfaction.

● Picture Quality: Look for strong brightness, rich colors, and good contrast to enjoy clear and detailed visuals in different lighting conditions.
● Display Technology: Choose a screen with reliable panel quality and smooth motion for comfortable viewing during movies, sports, and regular entertainment.
● Smart Features: Select a TV with an easy interface, popular streaming support, and simple navigation to quickly access your favorite content.
● Connectivity: Ensure multiple ports and wireless options are available to connect gaming devices, sound systems, and other accessories without difficulty.

Q.

Which 4K TV should I choose?

A.

Choosing the right 4K TV depends on your room size, viewing distance, and entertainment needs. These LG models offer different screen sizes for comfortable, immersive viewing.

 

● 43NU870BPLA: A practical 108 cm (43) choice for smaller rooms and closer viewing distances. Its compact size makes it easy to fit into different spaces.

● 55NU875BPLA: A 139 cm (55) option for viewers who want a larger screen for movies, shows, sports, gaming, and streaming.

● 55NU880BPLA: This 139 cm (55) model suits those who want a larger display with a balanced viewing experience for everyday entertainment.

● 55NU885BPLA: Another 139 cm (55) option, it offers a spacious screen for comfortable viewing and an engaging entertainment experience.

 

Best choice: Choose the 108 cm (43) model for compact spaces, while the 139 cm (55) options are good for larger rooms and immersive viewing.

Q.

Which 4K TVs are the most popular this year?

A.

The most popular 4K TVs combine clear picture quality, smart features, and screen sizes for different viewing needs. Among LG’s options, the 55UA83506LA and 65NU870BPLA offer engaging choices for everyday entertainment.

 

● 55UA83506LA: This 139 cm (55) 4K UHD TV is best for movies, shows, sports, gaming, and streaming. Its balanced screen size makes it a practical choice for many living spaces.

● 65NU870BPLA: This 165 cm (65) 4K UHD TV provides a larger viewing area for a more immersive experience. It is well-suited to spacious rooms and viewers who prefer a bigger screen for entertainment.

 

Screen size: The 139 cm (55) model suits moderate spaces, while the 165 cm (65) model works well when you want a larger, more cinematic viewing experience.

Q.

Which 4K TVs are highly rated for durability?

A.

Highly rated 4K TVs for durability should offer dependable performance, sturdy design, and features suited for long-term everyday use. LG’s NU870BPLA range provides different screen sizes for varied viewing spaces.

 

● 55NU870BPLA: The 139 cm (55) offers a spacious viewing area with a durable design, making it suitable for family entertainment and regular use.

● 50NU870BPLA: This 126 cm (50) option provides a balanced screen size for medium-sized rooms while delivering a clear 4K viewing experience.

● 43NU870BPLA: The 108 cm (43) is suitable for smaller rooms and compact spaces. Its smaller footprint makes it easy to accommodate in different setups.

Q.

Are there any good 4K TV deals on Black Friday?

A.

Yes, Black Friday can be a good time to find attractive deals on 4K TVs, with seasonal promotions offering discounts across different models and screen sizes. Visit LG’s promotional page for the latest LG TV offers, available discounts, and ongoing deals. When comparing options, consider the screen size, picture quality, smart features, specifications, and overall value to find a TV that suits your needs. Larger 139 cm (55) and 165 cm (65) models can offer an immersive viewing experience, while smaller options may be suitable for compact spaces. Checking the promotional page regularly during the Black Friday period can help you stay updated on available 4K TV offers and choose an option that fits your requirements and budget.

Q.

Which 4K TVs come with voice control?

A.

Many LG 4K TVs have voice control, making it easier to search for content, adjust settings, and access smart features using simple voice commands. The following models offer convenient voice-enabled features for everyday entertainment.

 

● 55NU875BPLA: A 139 cm (55) 4K TV with voice control features for easier navigation and content discovery.

● 43NU875BPLA: A compact 108 cm (43) option that provides voice-enabled smart functions while fitting comfortably into smaller spaces.

● 65NU880BPLA: A larger 165 cm (65) model suited for spacious rooms, with voice control for convenient interaction with smart features.

● 55NU880BPLA: A 139 cm (55) option combining a comfortable screen size with voice-enabled smart functionality for everyday viewing.

Q.

Which 4K TVs are best for color richness?

A.

For vibrant, natural, and detailed pictures, choose a 4K TV with strong color technology. The right model can make movies, sports, shows, and games look brighter, deeper, and more lifelike.

 

● 55NU885BPLA: This 139 cm (55) model is a great choice for viewers who want a bigger screen with rich colors and sharp 4K details. Its picture technology helps improve brightness, contrast, and overall image depth. It works especially well for living rooms and family entertainment.

● 43NU880BPLA: This 108 cm (43) model is suitable for smaller rooms and closer viewing. It delivers clear 4K pictures with vibrant colors, good contrast, and detailed images. It is a practical option when you want strong picture quality without choosing a larger screen.

Q.

How much should I expect to pay for a 4K TV?

A.

You can expect to pay anywhere from under ₹40,000 to ₹70,000 or more for an LG 4K TV in India, depending on the screen size, display technology, and features. LG India offers various 4K TVs across different price ranges, from everyday UHD models to premium NANO options. For a balance of picture quality and value, the ₹40,000–₹70,000 range can be a good starting point, while higher budgets can get you advanced display technology, richer contrast, and a more premium viewing experience. Prices may also vary based on offers and promotions.

Q.

What HDR TVs offer the best value for the price?

A.

For strong HDR performance without overspending, LG’s 4K UHD and QNED ranges offer some of the better value options. The best choice depends on your budget, room lighting, and how much you value color, contrast, and premium features.

 

● LG UHD 4K TVs: A budget-friendly option, offering 4K resolution, HDR10 Pro, AI picture processing, and smart features for everyday viewing.

● LG QNED TVs: A stronger value choice if you want richer colors and better contrast. QNED models use advanced color technology, while MiniLED models provide improved brightness and contrast.

● LG OLED TVs: Best for premium HDR viewing, especially movies. OLED delivers deep blacks and excellent contrast, but costs more than UHD and QNED options.

Q.

What HDR TVs are recommended by professionals for high-end viewing?

A.

For high-end HDR viewing, professionals generally recommend premium OLED TVs because they deliver excellent contrast, deep blacks, bright highlights, and rich, accurate colors. LG’s OLED evo G6 is a standout choice for 2026, with LG positioning it as its flagship OLED and equipping it with Hyper Radiant Color Tech, the α11 AI Processor Gen3, Dolby Vision, and enhanced brightness. The G6 series is best for its vibrant HDR colors, strong brightness, and excellent reflection handling.

 

For a more balanced premium option, the LG OLED evo C6 offers high-end 4K OLED picture quality and Dolby Vision, while costing less than the flagship G6.

Enhance everything you watch with the all-new range of UHD TVs by LG. The LG 4K UHD TV now comes with AI ThinQ built-in, along with Ultra high-definition picture quality to give you a complete viewing experience. Explore the full features of LG UHD TV.

 

Features of LG UHD TV

 

• Real 4K TV

 LG UHD TV was made to entertain you by taking everything you watch to a new level. Whether it's cinema, sports, or games, it delivers real 4K images with vivid color and fine detail. Enjoy more realistic images  in four times the resolution of Full HD.

 

• Quad Core Processor 4K

  The processor removes video noise and creates more vibrant color and contrast. Low-resolution images are upscaled and reproduced at close to 4K quality.

 

 • AI ThinQ

   Intelligent LG AI ThinQ makes life even more convenient. Natural voice recognition allows you to command and control your Home IoT ecosystem.

 

• Filmmaker Mode

 The processor automatically turns off motion smoothing for the full motion picture effect. Watch films and other content with the creative intent and cinematic experience preserved.

 

• HDR 10 Pro & HLG Pro

 The best 4K UHD TV in India provides the user an optimal HDR picture quality with the support of major HDR formats including HDR 10 Pro and HLG Pro.

 

• Ultra-Surround

 Multiple virtual audio channels create a more immersive sound experience. Enjoy subtle dialogue and sophisticated sound as if you were in the scene itself.

 

• Unlimited Entertainment

  Dive into the wide variety of content to choose from Disney+ Hotstar, the Apple TV app, Netflix and Prime Videos. From the latest movies, TV shows, and documentaries, live sports and more, find them all here in one place. Just sit back and enjoy.

 

• HGiG for HDR Gaming

 HGiG recognizes TV performance and picture quality then tunes HDR graphics to provide the ultimate HDR gaming experience.

 

• Wide Viewing Angle

 Watch your favorite sports team play on a display with spectacularly realistic colors, no matter where you sit.

 

• Bluetooth Surround Ready

 Create a surround sound effect by connecting any two Bluetooth speakers to your LG UHD TV. Be more immersed in the game and feel the live atmosphere.

 

• Sports Alert

 Sports Alert notifies you before, during, and after games. Don't worry about missing the big plays, even when you're watching something else.

 

• webOS

 Get a wide variety of OTT content at your fingertips. Your favorite movies, TV shows, documentaries, live sports and more are now all in one place.
